title: Vibrant Dense Venezuelan Shrimp Pilaf
description: A comforting Venezuelan dish featuring shrimp, paste, and kapi, made with macrobiotic friendly ingredients and a hint of mustard, this pilaf is a dense and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the saucepan and set aside.
Add the kapi paste, mustard, salt, and pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the uncooked rice to the saucepan and stir to coat the rice with the kapi paste mixture.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the cooked shrimp.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
